corpus_rule: The same 36 defects as h-loss-corpus.json, in the same order. Classified under the locating rule fixed in H_DISTINCTION_PREREG.md: a collapse or separation may be located ONLY in a projection, never in a consumer's decision procedure.

entries.projection: scope map: unestablished dimension -> missing key
entries.why: never-established and not-asked-about share one representation

entries.projection: context map: absent dimension -> missing key
entries.why: not-established and for-all share one representation
minted-by-constructor and carries-this-symbol share one observable

entries.projection: admission -> dimension NAME as registry key
entries.why: admitted-by-pytest and admitted-by-git share one key
a reserved key and a user key share one admissibility representation

entries.projection: shadowing -> removal from the carried map
entries.why: was-shadowed and never-carried share one representation
P-at-S1 and P-at-S2 share one id
several production histories share one digest
a relevant and an irrelevant pending item share one representation
terminal-by-nature and terminal-on-this-path share one measurement
a refuter at S1 and one at S2 share one edge representation

entries.projection: reestablish argument -> scope, identity not consulted at the projection
entries.why: the encoded scope and the supplied scope share one stored field
a stale and a fresh witness share one edge
unmeasured and equal share one cell value
an absent version and the literal text undefined share one string
a failed record and a real one share one slot shape
distinct producers sharing a name share one representation
no-restriction-stated and every-world share one representation
an absent dimension and one being narrowed share one representation

the token KIND was carried, distinct and readable at every step; no projection merged EPISTEMIC with NORMATIVE and none separated equivalents. commit() had the distinction in hand and did not branch on it. Under the locating rule that is a consumer failing to consult, which is explicitly NOT a collapse.
[A,B] and [B,A] are equivalent for what may be derived, and project to different premises
a refusal and an output with no coordinates share one projection
came-from-outside and redundantly-supported share one label
could-not-measure and measured-an-absence share one value
the fact that supports a coordinate and any fact sharing its name share one test
a refusal and an empty-coordinate output share one projection
could-not-build and built-identically share one path

entries.projection: byResult: object identity -> ONE producer node
entries.why: the inner producer and the validating wrapper share one entry
constructed premises and the target's own argument facts share one group set

entries.projection: translation of a scope into a calculus context
entries.why: ANY and a specific value both become an ordinary context value

entries.projection: context comparison -> strict inequality over references
entries.why: structurally identical scopes are equivalent for the permission question and project to different references

entries.projection: child process -> exit code plus stdout
